const sampleId = $input.item.json.sample_id;
const projectId = $input.item.json.PROJECT_ID;
const files = $input.item.json.files;

const sampleSheet = `[Header],,,,,,,,,,,
IEMFileVersion,4,,,,,,,,,,
Investigator Name,Can Holyavkin,,,,,,,,,,
Experiment Name,TSO500_ctDNA,,,,,,,,,,
Date,${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US')},,,,,,,,,,
Workflow Version,Acadia 500 Liquid Workflow v0.0.1,,,,,,,,,,
Flowcell ID,,,,,,,,,,,
FileFormatVersion,2,,,,,,,,,,
[Reads],,,,,,,,,,,
Read1Cycles,151,,,,,,,,,,
Read2Cycles,151,,,,,,,,,,
Index1Cycles,8,,,,,,,,,,
Index2Cycles,8,,,,,,,,,,
[BCLConvert_Settings],,,,,,,,,,,
SoftwareVersion,3.6.3,,,,,,,,,,
AdapterRead1,AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA,,,,,,,,,,
AdapterRead2,AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT,,,,,,,,,,
AdapterBehavior,trim,,,,,,,,,,
MinimumTrimmedReadLength,35,,,,,,,,,,
MaskShortReads,35,,,,,,,,,,
[BCLConvert_Data],,,,,,,,,,,
Sample_ID,index,index2,OverrideCycles,,,,,,,,
${sampleId},AGCGATAG,TTATTCGT,U7N1Y143;I8;I8;U7N1Y143,,,,,,,,

[TSO500L_Settings],,,,,,,,,,,
[TSO500L_Data],,,,,,,,,,,
Sample_ID,Index_ID,index,index2,Sample_Name,Sample_Plate,Sample_Well,I7_Index_ID,I5_Index_ID,Project,Sample_Description,Sample_Type
${sampleId},UP05,AGCGATAG,TTATTCGT,${sampleId},,,D712,D513,,${sampleId},DNA
`;

return {
  json: {
    sample_id: sampleId,
    sample_sheet_content: sampleSheet,
    sample_sheet_filename: `SampleSheet_${sampleId}_ctDNA.csv`,
    files: files,
    PROJECT_ID: projectId
  }
};

=  echo '{{ $json.sample_sheet_content }}' > /tmp/{{ $json.sample_sheet_filename }} && icav2 projectdata upload /tmp/{{ $json.sample_sheet_filename }} "/samplesheet_folder/{{ $json.sample_sheet_filename }}" --project-id {{
  $json.PROJECT_ID }} 2>&1 | grep "^id" | awk '{print $2}'

=  icav2 projectpipelines start nextflow "b4dec62d-f3af-4dc3-8d15-6fe6c9a4df6c" \
    --project-id {{ $('Prepare Pipeline Launch HRD').item.json.PROJECT_ID }} \
    --storage-size "Large" \
    --output-parent-folder {{ $('Loop Over Items HRD').item.json.output_folder_id }} \
    --input "run_folder:{{ $('Loop Over Items HRD').item.json.input_folder_id }}" \
    --input "sample_sheet:{{ $('Prepare Pipeline Launch HRD').item.json.samplesheet_id }}" \
    --parameters "StartsFromFastq:true" \
    --user-reference "{{ $('Prepare Pipeline Launch HRD').item.json.sample_id }}-analysis" 2>&1 | grep "^id" | awk '{print $2}'

=  echo '{{ JSON.stringify($("Prepare Pipeline Launch HRD").item.json.files) }}' | jq -r '.[]' | while read filename; do
    FILE_ID=$(curl -s -X GET 'https://ica.illumina.com/ica/rest/api/projects/{{ $("Prepare Pipeline Launch HRD").item.json.PROJECT_ID }}/data?filePath=/input_folder/&type=FILE&pageSize=1000' \
      -H 'Accept: application/vnd.illumina.v3+json' \
      -H 'X-API-Key: RBsYkBubZxrPXkR3AvjLXUlYFGJJ8FOM' | \
      jq -r ".items[] | select(.data.details.name == \"$filename\") | .data.id")

    if [ ! -z "$FILE_ID" ]; then
      icav2 projectdata update "$FILE_ID" --project-id {{ $("Prepare Pipeline Launch HRD").item.json.PROJECT_ID }} --remove-user-tag "on_hold" --add-user-tag "analysis_completed" 2>&1
      echo "Updated: $filename ($FILE_ID)"
    fi
  done
